allow: PowerShell(foreach \($p in 8080,8081,8082,11434\) { $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $c[0].OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "$p LISTENING \(PID $\($c[0].OwningProcess\) $\($proc.ProcessName\)\)" } else { Write-Output "$p free" } })
